name: agentmemory
description: Persistent memory for the coding agents you run in Orca: browse and search what they learned, send a memory to an agent, open the files it mentions and the viewer in Orca, and optionally capture agent tool calls.

cover.alt: The agentmemory panel in Orca, listing the latest memories of the open project

screenshots.alt: The agentmemory panel with memory counts, search, a project filter and recent memories
screenshots.caption: Counts, search and the latest memories of the open project

settings.title: Server URL
settings.description: Where the agentmemory server listens. The bearer secret is read from AGENTMEMORY_SECRET, ~/.agentmemory/.env or ~/.agentmemory/secret, and is only sent to a loopback address or over HTTPS.

settings.title: Viewer URL
settings.description: Opened in an Orca browser tab by Open viewer and by the status bar item.

settings.title: Capture agent tool calls
settings.description: Send the tool calls of agents running in Orca to agentmemory. Leave this off for agents you connected with agentmemory connect, which capture through their own hooks; turning it on for them records each call twice.
